g.text: Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium, 2003–2017 | 1,350 dates in the supplied seasonal diary
Fifteen years of daily spawning records
Blue: number of tanks recorded spawning. Light grey: zero in the diary. White beyond each strip: outside the supplied window.
Triangles mark full-moon dates in the source's lunar alignment. Tank counts and available colonies can differ between years.
Source: Sakai, Yamamoto & Maruyama (2024), Zenodo 10974150, CC BY 4.0. This aquarium series is kept separate from wild reefs.
